claim.summary: Admissible numbering transfer: over any field, for the functional pigeonhole system (Booleanity, hole and functionality axioms, pigeon axioms Q_i = 1 - sum_j x_ij, multilinear ring) with any number m of pigeons and N >= 1 holes, D <= ceil(N/2), C the degree-D PC closure of all axioms and H that of the hole and functionality axioms alone: if a set F of monomial errors with K+|E|<=D has one numbering of pigeons and holes in which, for every matching E in F and every dance-admissible x_t in T_K cap B_K (Impagliazzo-Pudlak-Sgall basis) with t cup E a matching, x_{t cup E} is in B_D, then the common kernel of the x_E in V_K modulo C equals the common kernel modulo H plus C cap V_K. Equivalently the IPS projection R satisfies R(x_E r) = x_E r modulo H on its image.
claim.assessment: Working proof passed by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer in two follow-ups; the criterion is sufficient, not necessary, and needs the union of the errors' hole sets to miss a hole.

claim.summary: Exact operator criterion: over any field, for functional unary PHP^m_N (m > N), d <= ceil(N/2) and any set A of polynomials of degree <= d, with R the projection of span(T_d) onto span(T_d cap B_d) along K_d = span(B_d minus T_d) (the Impagliazzo-Pudlak-Sgall basis and PC closure of the pigeon axioms, ECCC TR97-042 Prop. 2.8 and Thm 2.9), the degree-d PC closure of the pigeon axioms and A is K_d + W_A, W_A the smallest subspace containing R(a) and R(xw) for w in W_A with deg(xw) <= d; so PHP plus A has a degree-d refutation iff 1 is in W_A (the complete-board form of lem:relative-criterion, with converse). R(f) = 0 iff every functional vanishing on K_d kills f; the uniform design lambda(x_U) = 1/(N)_{|U|} is a PHP design, so dense clauses have R(C) != 0 when their uniform value is nonzero. Hardness of the functional system implies hardness of weak PHP plus A. The operator method reformulates hardness exactly and does not bypass the splitting condition.
claim.assessment: Working proof after a fresh-context review, given the imported basis theorem; part (3) is corrected by cor:uniform-design-characteristic (the uniform design needs (N)_d invertible, so over F_3 only d <= 2); parts (1), (2), (4) and the no-bypass conclusion stand.

significance.rationale: Develops and closes the operator lead: exactness shows the method is a reformulation, not a bypass, for dense clauses.

claim.summary: Conjecture: for the functional pigeonhole system over F_2 (pigeon axioms 1+sum_j x_ij, hole and functionality axioms, multilinear ring) with n+1 pigeons and n holes, at a proper degree D, K<=D-1, and any set F of monomial errors E with K+deg E<=D, the common kernel {u in V_K: uE in C for E in F} modulo the degree-D closure C equals the common kernel modulo the closure H of the hole and functionality axioms alone, plus C cap V_K. claim.summary: For the product pigeonhole system (m pigeons, n>=1 holes) at D=n over any field, an error E of degree e with K+e<=n and support S_E on the hole-respecting assignments Y: if the unplaced-pigeon indicators restricted to Y minus S_E are linearly independent, then for f of degree <=K, fE lies in the closure exactly when f vanishes on S_E. The independence holds when Y minus S_E contains the empty assignment and, for each pigeon, an assignment placing only it; it also holds for every monomial error of degree e>=1 on distinct holes, for all m and n (at n=1 by a separate argument). For K+e<=n-1 the conclusion needs no hypothesis; the content is K+e=n. With lem:cylinder-killer-degree, the six errors x_jj x_ll on the hole pairs at m=5, n=4, D=4, K=2 have no surviving common killer of degree 2, the least degree being tau(K_4)=3.
claim.assessment: Working proof passed by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer of the cylinder-killers entry with a follow-up (review record in research/results/common_multiplier_cylinder_killers_20261016); "the closure" is the degree-n PC closure of the product pigeonhole system, as in the entry. The assessment field was left at its draft value at registration and filled on 16 October 2026 from that record.
